values: All distinct base building identifiers found in the currently linked public BINVOX.zip archive. Retrieved October 2, 2026.
The same building at different resolutions counts once. Augmentation suffixes _0, _30, …, _330 are removed from base identifiers.
TARGET_064_BINVOX; TARGET_128_BINVOX; TARGET_256_BINVOX; TARGET_512_BINVOX. Each contains the same 95 identifiers.
TARGETAUGMENTED_064_BINVOX. Contains 12 samples for each of 95 identifiers.
Muuratsalo Experimental House; La Rotonda; Ennis House.
Meteorite Cabin; Lowell Beach House; Hare House.

The paper reports 1,500 models including augmentation. The linked release has 1,235 files at resolution 64 (95 original + 1,140 augmented). This workbook establishes the released archive inventory, not a verified roster of every model used in the published experiments.

Building names are readable versions of source filenames, not independently verified official names. Source spellings such as “Jacob House”, “Lowell Beach House”, “Okurayama Apartement”, and “Wind Chinmey” are retained. Glass House entries are distinguished by the architect encoded in the filename.

Dataset identifiers are base filenames without .binvox or augmentation suffixes. ZIP filenames were decoded as UTF-8. Author/modeler tokens and source spelling are preserved. __MACOSX metadata, directories, and .DS_Store files are excluded.
